title: Medieval, Mystical, Merciless
description:
An epic, somewhat lightweight mod pack that has cool mobs, epic biomes and caves, and its just a tad bit hard!

(you are in for a surprise if you believe that)
body:
Welcome to Medieval, Mystical, Merciless. A semi-hard survival mod pack that uses big mods such as Alex's mobs, and Ice and Fire. This mod pack was built with Conquest Reforged, which was used as the template. With some slight configuration in your settings, this is a mod pack that looks good on both potato's, and supercomputers. This mod is made with about 150 mods. This mod was tested on a system with a Nvidia GT 1030, Intel 4950, and 16 GB of ram. I recommend allocating 6-8 GB ram. The Absolute minimum is 4, but expect lag. I recommend having about 16GB of ram to ensure your system doesn't explode. This probably cant run on intergrated graphics, but that depends on your cpu. For a graphics card, The minimum is probably a GT 1030, but i dont really know This mod has a ton of optimizers to make sure you squeeze every bit of performance in this. Have fun in the fog! Note: NONE of these mods are mine. All credit goes to their original creator", 
[Bobby mod](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/bobby/files/all?page=1&pageSize=20&version=1.20.1&gameVersionTypeId=4&showAlphaFiles=hide)
